answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral to participate in consensus. This economic barrier acts like a karst landscape, where hidden costs erode malicious influence. Just as a trellis supports growth, verifiable staking history structures legitimate participation. An attacker faces the basalt weight of slashing penalties, ensuring that creating infinite fake identities remains prohibitively expensive and economically irrational.
